Flow Builder is one of Adapty's core products and the biggest bet we're making right now.
Our customers use it to assemble the screens their users see before paying: onboarding, quizzes, paywalls, and post-purchase experiences. They build multi-screen flows with branching, variables, and conditional content directly in the browser. The Adapty SDK renders those flows natively on iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and Capacitor, and a change published in the editor reaches users without an app release.
We're building the most capable native-rendering builder on the market, and that sets a high bar for engineering. This is an editor with the complexity of a design tool: a document model, a layer tree, layout and styling systems, a preview that has to agree with five runtimes, and an AI Editor that can rewrite the screen you're looking at from a prompt.
It's closer to Figma than to a dashboard, with subscription revenue running through every screen it renders.
We're hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to own the frontend of Flow Builder and help shape what it becomes. You'd set architectural direction rather than pick up specced tickets, work with the SDK team on the config contract, and take features from a customer problem to production. It's a small team, with no analysts between you and the decision.

Take features from a customer problem to production: decide with product and design what to build, defend the call, ship it, and check what changed after release.
Own the architecture of the editor and move it forward as the product grows: module boundaries, the shape of the document model, where reusable components live, and keeping the editor fast when a flow grows from four screens to hundreds of branches.
